deck.request: Has Northvale Rail recovered, how does it compare with other operators, and what should it buy next?
deck.brief: Has Northvale Rail recovered, and what should it buy next?
deck.answer: Northvale has recovered past its FY19 level and leads its peers, so it should buy frequency on its four busiest lines.
